test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What does the word "tyrannically" most closely mean in the phrase "tyrannically centred on the author"?

options.text: In a cruel and absolute way

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. in a cruel and absolute way.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"tyrannically"** means in a manner that is oppressive, unjustly harsh, or autocratic; resembling a tyrant, using power in a cruel or arbitrary manner.

 
 
• **Example:** The dictator ruled tyrannically, suppressing any form of dissent.
 
 
 
• In the phrase "tyrannically centred on the author," "tyrannically" implies that the focus on the author is done in a manner that is absolute and possibly oppressive or harsh.
 
 
• **Example:** The company was tyrannically centered on the CEO, with no room for dissenting opinions.
 
 

Therefore, the meaning of "tyrannically" in the given context is: **in a cruel and absolute way.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options and their meanings:

 
• **Carefully and thoughtfully** (सावधानीपूर्वक और सोच-समझकर): Doing something with attention to detail and consideration.

 
 
• **Example:** She prepared her speech carefully and thoughtfully.
 
 
 
• **Rarely and unpredictably** (कभी-कभी और अप्रत्याशित रूप से): Happening infrequently and not in a predictable manner.
 
 
• **Example:** The weather in that region changes rarely and unpredictably.
 
 
 
• **Traditionally and legally** (परंपरागत रूप से और कानूनी रूप से): Following customs or laws.
 
 
• **Example:** The practice was carried out traditionally and legally.
